user.title: Connect to your Marantz receiver
user.description: Choose how Home Assistant talks to the receiver.

network.title: Network connection
network.description: Set the receiver's Network > Network Control option to "Always On" so it can be turned on from standby.

data_description.serial_url: A local device such as /dev/ttyUSB0, or a pyserial URL such as socket://192.168.1.10:4001 (raw TCP serial server) or rfc2217://192.168.1.10:4001.

data.sources: Sources shown in the source list
